bundle.shortDescription: One prompt, many AI chat sites side by side
bundle.longDescription: Multi Mind opens AI chat websites in resizable panes, sends your prompt to every active site at once, and lets you compare their answers in one window. It uses the sites' own interfaces and your signed-in sessions, so no API keys are needed.
